_note: bows (docs/specs/bows.md). Bows are the only ranged weapon. Bows are Items (template x material x quality), held in the 'ranged' equip slot; arrows are counted goods (economy goods of the same id) carried in a quiver (Unit.quiver {arrow id: count}, max 50). Bow stats: draw_n = draw weight in newtons at full draw, draw_m = draw length in metres, eff = efficiency (arrow energy / energy drawn) for a reference 60 g arrow, virt_kg = virtual mass of the limbs (a heavier arrow takes more of the bow's energy, src: bow physics, values ours), cm3 = wood volume (mass = cm3 x wood density), min_range = tiles inside which the archer goes to his sidearm (spec ~2, tune), value = base gold. inputs = goods one bow takes (bowyer), rate = bows per bowyer worker-day. Stored energy ~ 0.5 x draw weight x draw length (spec). Anchors (not targets): hunting bow ~50 J, war bow ~100-130 J. All values ours [tuned].
_shapes_note: Arrowhead shapes (spec 3). contact = DF contact area (a point bites through small), pen = cutting depth in DF penetration units (x0.01 mm) the head and shaft can drive in, tear = exit tear multiplier when the arrow is pulled out on the field (broadheads tear more). Wood points are the sharpened, fire-hardened shaft itself.
_arrows_note: Arrow kinds (counted goods; the economy goods table holds their price and weight). Shaft always wood. Mass = shaft_kg + tip_cm3 x tip material density. w_size_cm3 = head volume for the DF blunt-deflection test (wood points use the shaft tip).
_culture_note: Arrow kinds each culture's armories, militias and forces keep (first = preferred), and the sidearm each culture's archers carry (from its own weapons).
